arguments.summary: Fixed the flag parsing bug in flags/parse.py where a value like "off " (trailing space) was treated as true. The `parse_flag` function only lowercased the input without stripping whitespace, so "off " didn't match the false-word "off" and fell through to `True`. Added `.strip()` to the normalization...
